Done. Here's a summary:

- **Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** Rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollout was confirmed complete in all three regions.
- **Incident:** Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback action, and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Follow-up recommendation: investigate what in v2.3.1 caused the failure before attempting another release.
